newsitem.title: JAPAN: Showa Shell ask-only on downward earnings revision.
newsitem.headline: Showa Shell ask-only on downward earnings revision.

text.p: Showa Shell Sekiyu KK shares were ask-only in the Monday morning session, as investors were discouraged by a downward revision in its earnings forecast, brokers said.
As of 0152 GMT, the shares of the oil refiner and distributor were ask-only at 926 yen after closing at 956 yen on Friday.
On Friday, Showa Shell said it revised its parent current forecast for the year to December 31, 1996 to 12.00 billion yen from a previous prediction of 20.00 billion yen.
